name: Don't Cry, Samurai
source:
You've always dreamed of becoming the greatest samurai in all the south villages. However, that dream is starting to drift away with each passing day. If you don't think of something soon, you will fail to fulfill your promise to him. You will never be worthy of his love.

You will never be able to forgive yourself.

As if it were fate, you meet a kitsune who seems eager to help you accomplish your dream in exchange for something in return. She seems oddly familiar but kind nonetheless.

But kitsunes always have a price. Are you willing to pay it?

[From [url=https://lunarmoonstudios.itch.io/dont-cry-samurai]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你一直梦想成为南方所有村庄中最伟大的武士。然而，这个梦想正开始随着时间的推移而渐行渐远。如果你不尽快想办法，你就无法履行对他的承诺。你永远不配得到他的爱。

你永远无法原谅自己。

就像命运一样，你遇到了一只狐狸，他似乎渴望帮助你实现你的梦想，以换取一些回报。她看上去有种奇怪的熟悉感，但又很友善。

但狐妖总是有代价的。你愿意付钱吗？

[来自[url=https://lunarmoonstudios.itch.io/dont-cry-samurai]itch.io[/url]]
